entry.title: New: dsh-wsl-expose
entry.summary: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports. Exact install spec: dsh-wsl-expose. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
